scope: Six migrated contracts across two batches, not a complete ADR obligation inventory.

contracts.obligation: Authoritative member replacement fails hard and atomically: a mid-write failure preserves the prior durable members and parent timestamp; the connection recovers for a subsequent replacement.
contracts.case_name: ADR-0055: member replacement rolls back on mid-write failure and recovers
contracts.oracle: A PostgreSQL trigger witnesses delete plus first insert before rejecting the second insert. An independent connection reads unchanged durable state; fault removal permits the same replacement and clear.
defects: Commit the deletion before inserting replacement members: the old happy-path case passes, the new durable rollback observations fail.
limits: One member-replacement obligation, not all BaselineStore or migration conformance.
Requires a disposable PostgreSQL service with database-creation privileges.

contracts.obligation: Transient failure preserves exact buffered heartbeat data; recovery delivers it and new work once, without replacing the owner process or replaying acknowledged data.
contracts.oracle: Synchronous failed/successful/empty flushes observe exact RPC payloads, process identity and no duplicate delivery. Fixture teardown releases owned processes/mocks and restores environment; supporting sensitivity probes check that cleanup.
defects: Drop snapshot bytes while preserving heartbeat count.
Replay an already acknowledged batch on the next flush.
limits: Real heartbeat/upstream gen_servers with mocked RPC and telemetry; not HTTP/2 or protobuf wire proof.
ADR-0069 supplies related architecture, not this precise retry obligation.

contracts.obligation: The production scanner rejects the reserved __guard__ name without exposing a dispatch candidate, while accepting and executing an ordinary ABI3 control from the same selected build.
contracts.case_name: PluginLoader rejects a plugin declaring a reserved name
contracts.oracle: Direct fixture loads pin identities; scan returns exactly the working ordinary plugin and the reserved-name diagnostic. Explicit build-root absence cannot fall back to a stale CWD artifact.
defects: Reject every plugin, including the positive control.
Remove a required selected-build fixture while leaving a stale copy in CWD.
limits: Only the __guard__ runtime example; pure tests cover the larger reserved set.
Other loader fixture discovery families are not migrated by this pilot.

contracts.obligation: Cutoff flooring preserves rows at the boundary while anchors retain raw time; crossing midnight by two milliseconds neither fabricates a clock jump nor changes the strict deletion boundary.
contracts.case_name: Retention cutoff preserves boundary rows and raw anchors across midnight
contracts.oracle: Fixed SQL clock readings straddle midnight; an independent PostgreSQL connection checks exact committed IDs, timestamps and raw anchor after each production prune, including boundary survivors and deletion counts.
defects: Remove cutoff alignment: the old case passes while the replacement loses boundary rows.
Floor raw now before persisting the anchor and evaluating clock movement.
limits: Exercises the shared production helper with controlled now_expr, not consumer wiring or the live clock expression.
Requires a disposable PostgreSQL service with database-creation privileges.

authority.section: a row is removed with the agent process that owns

contracts.obligation: Owner death removes its registry routing, session and connection-index rows while retaining a live peer; the same registry can then register a replacement owner.
contracts.oracle: Raw ETS reads observe actual row removal after a monitored owner exits, unchanged live-control rows and exact replacement registration. Ownership-aware fixture cleanup is also exercised by supporting assertion-failure probes.
defects: Ignore agent DOWN messages: dead-PID lookup still returns error but owned rows remain.
Delete routing without removing session and connection-index entries.
limits: Registry-owned state only; supervisor crash-recovery bindings have a separate retention contract.
Related connection-slot coverage already exists in yuzu_gw_session_cap_tests; no wire or cross-node proof.

contracts.obligation: The scanner rejects one duplicate declared identity while preserving and executing both unique identities from the selected build.
contracts.case_name: PluginLoader rejects a second file declaring an already-loaded name
contracts.oracle: Direct loads identify two ABI3 copies and a distinct ABI4 control; scan accepts one of each, executes known actions, rejects unknown actions and reports exactly one duplicate path/reason.
defects: Reject every candidate after the first: old case passes while the distinct positive control fails.
Remove selected-build fixtures while retaining stale copies in CWD.
limits: Directory iteration chooses the winning duplicate; no filename-order promise.
Does not qualify plugin initialization, dispatcher integration or signing.
